contribution_types.description: Conceived the idea of generating a knowledge graph from web content
Incorporation: Switzerland, Bahamas
Suggested Singapore as a potential country for incorporating DAOs
Liquidity: Made introduction to Avichal Electric Capital

Shared the importance of Misneach, 
"the type of courage needed to continue doing something when you are weary and doubtful"
NFT minting: Giving so much power to governors sounds a bit risky.
Governance: Demostrated how it is possible to have alignment without consensus. A healthy dose of diverse and sometimes conflicting opinion is great!
Unstructured predictions are not necessarily unstructured You have technically turned it into a binary outcome. Did it or did it not happen?

The goal of crowdsourced validation for unstructured predictions is to determine if a stated event as generally  understood by the public did occur and less so if the stated event as understood by the original author did occur.

In that regard so long as the general public thinks an event did happen, it should be considered to have occurred even if its objectively nonsense

The 51% attack is a none issue

Proposed to reach out to 
https://agrifyfresh.com/

Suggested that the British East India company also involves with demand generation.

Tells colonies that English consumers need specific type of goods
Might extend into supply generation by buying up land in colonies to fulfill demand
Suggested that rather than focus on the top produce of each country focus on produce of the country with the highest arbitrage opportunity

Suggested the VCs need their 100X returns to fulfil LP requirements
There are a whole bunch of other problems (increasingly social ones) that are still lucrative to solve but not suitable for startups and VCs.

DAO is the solution to those problem
So DAO should just focus on solving that category of problem and not worry about competing with the VC funded startups

Also DAO due to its decentralized nature can solve some problems more effectively than traditional VC funded startups or companies.

Suggested that when trading volume through the network gets big enough to become the underwrite of risk (aka insurance provider)

Then suppliers or buyers can then do their own calculus to either insure the goods themselves or buy insurance from the DAO
Surfaced sunmit. EIC buys land too

DAO members should surface price of local community members.

Surfaced international smart contracts between communities

Caught severe copy writing error on package design

https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/.github/blob/main/assets/20230912%20-%20Vibhu%20caught%20copy%20error%20on%20package.jpg

Reach out to Journal who wrote about Africa Cacao issue to share our project

https://www.nytimes.com/2023/09/28/business/economy/ghana-cocoa-fairafric.html?unlocked_article_code=xRsUER69ObcWEROzisKB0tQ9aCFoatT4XAaRxExBfnfB26VJkxmjdxmjZf6PZR417N8LIh0G_Bn0JSyOIgZ4aGIVAnDflx5qxTryFW8n_IyMSwq5eupTzLqUsEF9d9YSAabdwlwAAts5IIvlR8pYD61Sww3BqXEyrlEM-D_Sy4FfD5e7h0t4Cuu3UOIGxUuyqD5_itF80vz2KvEh-a05pOtse_ah2OYl252ScNgsF_0D-AI29S6kcHl3kC_fE9DP2B_ZJm-VoNe9scQf9oJkLDGdWNpE3VXECLt1U-gBCtT-BzNgTVwvqJoPhqpBA5RA9uDJp_9Lj3O-ugpSqcQC2Fvuch1UEwk9&smid=nytcore-ios-share&referringSource=articleShare

Surfaced upcoming regulation on against fraud in the food industry

https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2023/10/12/food-fraud-cheese-technology/
Proposed to give the homeless a T-shirt since CPM value will far exceed the cost

The Singapore experience is memorably captured in The LAST FOOLS — https://www.goodreads.com/en/book/show/61181334

Well worth reading for any one, especially for those interested in how good planning  and user experience can result in a better product, even when the ‘product’ is something of the scale of Changi airport or the port of Singapore.
Shouldn’t you be meditating most of the time and only (very) intermittently replying to these messages? 🙂

As well as how to double down on the angle that Ben further surfaced using generative AI
Thanks @14806488258 for spending 5 minutes to share this critical piece of insight 🤩🙏

narrative.text: Vibhu Mittal contributed 25 times to TrueSight DAO, Agroverse, and telegram_chatlog projects from October 2018 to August 2025. His work centered on the Build Game - Strategy category, where he reviewed proposed strategies and suggested clear, specific actionable steps (4 contributions), logged 4 hours of human effort at 100 TDG per hour, and reviewed strategies with specific improvements (2 at 125 points, 1 at 250 points). Additional efforts included contributing reference materials via hyperlinks (2), warning against certain actions or areas to watch (1 at 150 points), suggesting an idea without implementation details (1), and providing reference material with strategy extension instructions (1 at 250 points).
